mapper.sql: sys08_code_kind_id AS code_kind_id, sys08_kind_cd AS kind_cd, sys08_kind_nm AS kind_nm, COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn, 'false') AS sys_yn, sys08_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys08_code_kind WHERE sys08_sys_yn LIKE #{sysYn} AND ( sys08_kind_nm LIKE #{kindName} OR lower(sys08_kind_cd) LIKE lower(#{kindName}) ) ORDER BY sys08_kind_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys08_code_kind (sys08_code_kind_id, sys08_kind_cd, sys08_kind_nm, sys08_sys_yn, sys08_note) VALUES (#{codeKindId}, #{kindCd}, #{kindNm}, #{sysYn}, #{note})
